verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is an integrations-directory entry for building custom dashboards and analytics from issue and project data (linear-docs-84). It appears to be a third-party integration rather than a native feature. Other routes also need extra tools: syncing data to warehouses via Fivetran or Airbyte for external BI (linear-intdir-12, linear-intdir-15), or sharing filtered and subscribable project views (linear-docs-13, linear-docs-61). Missing for 10: evidence of native dashboards or configurable widgets inside Linear, documentation of project-progress charts or report types, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
